subject: Copy of Newspaper Publication
detail: Britannia Industries Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication regarding the requests received for issue of Duplicate Share Certificate(s).

subject: Change in Management
detail: Pursuant to Regulation 30 read with Clause 7 of Para A of Part A of Schedule III of the SEBI ListingRegulations, 2015, this is to inform you that Mr. Puneet Das, Chief Marketing Officer, has decided to pursue an opportunity outside Britannia and has resigned from the services of the Company.
